AC-01.title: Graphify Engine AST Extraction
AC-01.evidence: Tree-sitter extraction across Python, TypeScript, and Go produces AST nodes and call/import edges with confidence EXTRACTED (1.0) without LLM dependencies.

AC-02.title: Incremental SHA256 Caching
AC-02.evidence: Workspace re-run achieves 100% cache hits. Stripping YAML frontmatter prevents AST invalidation when metadata alone changes.

AC-03.title: Multimodal Document Extraction
AC-03.evidence: DOCX, XLSX, Markdown, and PDF ingestion produces document nodes (file_type='document'), section hierarchies, tables, and rationale_for/cites edges.

AC-04.title: Leiden Community Partitioning
AC-04.evidence: NetworkX Leiden community detection clusters entities deterministically, splits oversized clusters (>25% total nodes), and isolates centrality god nodes.

AC-05.title: MCP Document Upload Tool
AC-05.evidence: Invoking projectbrain_upload_document in PB_MODE='remote' processes documents locally and streams JSON payloads to POST /sources/push-processed on the server.

AC-06.title: 63-Byte PostgreSQL Schema Isolation
AC-06.evidence: Sanitization formula pb_br_{proj[:16]}_{branch[:28]}_{hash8} guarantees collision-resistant PostgreSQL schema names <= 63 bytes conforming to ^[a-z_][a-z0-9_]{0,62}$.

AC-07.title: SQL Injection Resistance
AC-07.evidence: Branch names containing quotes and SQL statements are sanitized and interpolated exclusively through psycopg2.sql.Identifier.

AC-08.title: O(Delta) Branch-to-Root Diff
AC-08.evidence: Branch diffing inspects solely overlay tables without full table scans of canonical root.

AC-09.title: Branch-to-Branch Partial Diff
AC-09.evidence: Diffing branch A against branch B evaluates O(Delta_A union Delta_B) mutations, isolating added, modified, and deleted entities between overlays.

AC-10.title: Atomic Branch Promotion
AC-10.evidence: promote_branch_to_root executes within a single transaction: applies tombstones, upserts root records, drops branch schema CASCADE, and cleans registry.

AC-11.title: SQLite Overlay Fallback
AC-11.evidence: SqliteOverlayGraphStore emulates PostgreSQL schema overlay views via CTEs and prefixed tables offline.

AC-12.title: Local Partial Graphify Run
AC-12.evidence: projectbrain_sync_graphify with scoped_paths and local_only=True generates .projectbrain/local_graph/partial_graph.json.

AC-13.title: 3-Tier Hybrid KB Resolution
AC-13.evidence: projectbrain_hybrid_query resolves entities with strict precedence: local working overlay > server branch schema > canonical root schema.

AC-14.title: Tombstone Suppression
AC-14.evidence: Entities marked in node_tombstones or edge_tombstones are suppressed from resolved views and hybrid traversals.

AC-15.title: Web Dashboard Vis.js Compatibility
AC-15.evidence: Legacy endpoint /codegraph/data translates Graphify structures into Vis.js {nodes, edges} payloads.

AC-KB-01.title: Multi-Format Unified Document Ingestion & Chunking
AC-KB-01.evidence: DocumentPipeline and CodeDocLinker chunk Markdown, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, PDF, and CSV preserving hierarchical heading breadcrumbs and code fences.

AC-KB-02.title: Grounded AST Community Wiki Generation
AC-KB-02.evidence: ProjectDocSynthesizer generates grounded wiki pages including index.md, architecture_overview.md, api_and_mcp_reference.md, database_and_schemas.md, and Leiden community breakdowns.

AC-KB-03.title: Topological Graph Structural & Health Analysis
AC-KB-03.evidence: GRAPH_REPORT.md provides deterministic architectural health analysis isolating God nodes, degree distributions, and bridge components.

AC-KB-04.title: Multi-Sheet Excel Traceability Matrix Export
AC-KB-04.evidence: ProjectBrain_Traceability_Matrix.xlsx exports 4 sheets: Code_To_Doc_Links, Doc_Chunks_Inventory, API_And_MCP_Endpoints, and Coverage_And_Gaps.

AC-KB-05.title: Architectural Word Specification Generation
AC-KB-05.evidence: ProjectBrain_Architecture_Spec.docx exports formatted executive summaries, repository metric tables, subsystem architectures, and API catalog.

AC-KB-06.title: Executive PowerPoint Architecture Presentation
AC-KB-06.evidence: ProjectBrain_Architecture_Deck.pptx produces an executive deck covering system topology, Leiden modularity, God nodes, API/MCP tools, cognitive memory, and verification metrics.

AC-KB-07.title: Bidirectional Code-to-Doc-to-Test Cross-Linkage
AC-KB-07.evidence: CodeDocLinker establishes bidirectional cross-domain edges across documents_symbol, documented_in, specifies_endpoint, verifies_symbol, and conceptually_related_to relations.

AC-KB-08.title: Cross-Domain Code-Doc Drift Detection
AC-KB-08.evidence: CodeDocDrift engine detects source files modified more recently than linked docs, removed symbols lingering in documentation, and stale signature references.

AC-KB-09.title: Unified Traceability & Cross-Domain Query (kb-trace)
AC-KB-09.evidence: UnifiedKBBuilder.trace_code_and_docs and CLI kb-trace retrieve a unified composite view linking code AST nodes, doc chunks, test suites, callers, callees, and drift alerts.

AC-KB-10.title: Live End-to-End Knowledge Base Coverage & Verification
AC-KB-10.evidence: Full live KB verification passes all artifact, SQLite state, coverage threshold, and traceability assertions.

AC-PLG-01.title: Plugin Microkernel & Multi-Source Discovery
AC-PLG-01.evidence: PluginRegistry discovers all 25 built-in plugins across 9 categories, external plugin.json/plugin.py directories, and Python entry_points; supports priority resolution, per-project enable/disable/config, health_report(), and hot reload_directory().

AC-PLG-02.title: Zero-Regression Backward Compatibility
AC-PLG-02.evidence: Full pytest regression passes (268 passed, 5 skipped, 0 failed) with all existing baseline tests intact; get_graph_store() and UnifiedKBBuilder delegate cleanly to PluginRegistry.

AC-PLG-03.title: Pluggable Graph & Vector Backends
AC-PLG-03.evidence: GraphBackendPlugin (sqlite_overlay, postgres_schema, neo4j) and VectorBackendPlugin (hsg_memory, qdrant hybrid BM25+Dense) pass offline in memory mode and via mockable httpx transports.

AC-PLG-04.title: Legacy Testcase Canonical ETL
AC-PLG-04.evidence: etl.legacy_testcase parses CSV, .xlsx, TestRail JSON, and TestRail XML into Device-Independent Canonical Test Intent JSON with preconditions, steps, oracle assertions, priority, and target_platforms.

AC-PLG-05.title: Hardware Datasheet, OpenAPI & C++/Qt/ELF ETL
AC-PLG-05.evidence: etl.hardware_datasheet, etl.openapi31, and etl.cpp_embedded extract UART/AT/HardFault error rules, OpenAPI 3.1 endpoints/HTTP rules, C++/Qt signals & slots, and .ld/.map memory regions into GraphDelta nodes/edges.

AC-PLG-06.title: State/Screen Flow Graph & version_tag
AC-PLG-06.evidence: linker.state_flow constructs STATE_NODE, SCREEN_NODE, and TRANSITION_EDGE graphs scoped by version_tag (e.g., fw-v1.2) and diffs releases via diff_flow_versions; GET /v3/flow-graph queries by version_tag.

AC-PLG-07.title: Verified UDCP Script Cache & Auto-Invalidation
AC-PLG-07.evidence: ScriptCachePlugin (cache.sqlite_pg, cache.redis) stores UDCP commands, screen_hash, UI fingerprints, and self-heal history; auto-invalidates when fallback_rate > threshold after min_samples.

AC-PLG-08.title: Synchronized Telemetry & Evidence Index
AC-PLG-08.evidence: ArtifactStorePlugin (artifacts.local_sqlite, artifacts.minio_clickhouse) indexes all 8 evidence types by (run_id, step_id, ntp_timestamp_ms), aligns evidence windows with video_offset_ms, and purges expired TTL rows.

AC-PLG-09.title: Impact & Multi-Device Test DAG Planner
AC-PLG-09.evidence: brain.planner computes AST + Flow Graph blast radius, injects flash_firmware/install_app/power_cycle precondition nodes, binds cached UDCP scripts, and emits an acyclic Kahn-sorted test DAG.

AC-PLG-10.title: AI Test Oracle Criteria & Error Rule Judge
AC-PLG-10.evidence: brain.oracle retrieves SRS criteria, state transitions, UART/AT/HTTP error rules, and power budgets to emit deterministic PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE verdicts with violated rule references.

AC-PLG-11.title: RCA Triage, Deduplication & Self-Heal Loop
AC-PLG-11.evidence: brain.rca normalizes Crashpad/HardFault/UART/HTTP stacktraces into deterministic signature_hash values, deduplicates incidents (occurrence_count == 2), merges Jira/Linear ticket refs, classifies fault_domain, and invalidates FlakyScript cache entries.

AC-PLG-12.title: REST API, RBAC, FastMCP & CLI Exposure
AC-PLG-12.evidence: Exposes /plugins/* and /v3/* REST endpoints with PB_REQUIRE_REST_AUTH RBAC (401/403/200), PB_READ_ONLY enforcement, and _validate_safe_path traversal 400 rejection; registers all 10 FastMCP v3 tools with _is_write_tool & SSEFilter reader blocking; verifies plugins and v3-* CLI subcommands via subprocess.
